Package zephyr.wallet.model

Class ZephyrTransferQuery

java.lang.Object
zephyr.wallet.model.ZephyrTransfer
zephyr.wallet.model.ZephyrTransferQuery
All Implemented Interfaces:
Filter<ZephyrTransfer>
public class ZephyrTransferQuery extends ZephyrTransfer implements Filter<ZephyrTransfer>
Configures a query to retrieve transfers. All transfers are returned except those that do not meet the criteria defined in this query.
